I Rarely Wake Up Dreaming review – brilliant bulletin from Ukrainian frontline dives deep into culture war
stories.extract:
A movie’s themes could hardly be more urgent and contemporary than those on offer in this entirely absorbing film from German director Isabelle Stever and Ukrainian critic turned screenwriter Anna Melikova. It’s a bulletin from the frontline of Russia’s war on Ukraine, and from the culture war too. It is about identity and choices made in peacetime when less was at stake.
